notes.title: Virtual Wave (Demo PC/Mac) Available Now!
notes.notes:
Yes finally the PC/Mac Demo has been released for [i]Virtual Wave[/i]. You can download it now on:

[url=https://gamejolt.com/games/virtualwave/244114]GameJolt[/url]

or

[url=https://foxypanda.itch.io/virtual-wave]Itch.io[/url]

Currently [i]Virtual Wave[/i] is still in development for the final release, (hopefully by August 2019). I know I have been relatively silent on here but now I plan on updating my twitter and steam announcements regularly to help keep everyone who is interested informed. I am a one man team and it's a lot of work programming/designing as well as promoting through conventions/online all while keeping a part time and full time job. However I am dedicated to this project, I've wanted to make a video game since I was 6yo and I plan on following through on that dream.

Thank you all for your continued support,
[b]Jordan[/b] [FoxyPanda]
